title: The Road

vibeProfile.oneLine: A father and son walk through a dead world, carrying their love through it.

summary: A father and his young son walk south through a grey, ash-covered America after an unnamed catastrophe, scavenging for food and dodging the desperate remnants of humanity, carrying 'the fire' of their love and decency through a dead world. McCarthy strips his prose almost to the bone, and the result is unbearably tender as well as terrifying, one of the great books about parenthood disguised as a horror. Spare, devastating and, at its core, about the fiercest love there is.
whyReadIt: A horror of a dead world that is really the tenderest book about a father and son. Spare, devastating, unforgettable.

funFacts.text: It won the Pulitzer Prize; McCarthy dedicated it to his own young son.
